title: Document Control Workspace
chatHelp: Check change classification, review roles, publication controls, distribution, withdrawal, and urgent corrections.
questionPlaceholder: Does changing a numeric limit require a process-change review?
imagesHelp: Attach up to five PNG or JPEG images. Images provide context, not policy authority.
promptHelp: Choose a question to review a requirement, an exception, or an evidence gap.
searchPlaceholder: Search editorial correction, independent review, effective date, superseded copies, or urgent correction.
rawEvidenceHelp: Retrieved passages are source evidence. They are not a reviewed answer.
noAnswer: No assessment yet. Ask a question to examine the available evidence.
processHelp: Identify the current document and proposed change. The assessment checks review, publication, and distribution requirements.
emptyRegister: No document changes have been recorded.
evidenceAtTime: Evidence retained when this assessment was recorded
validationError: Check the highlighted fields and use the required format.
requestFailed: The request could not be completed. Try again or contact the workspace owner.
